set.body:
Goal: make the vendor conversion step reproducible even though conversion occurs outside the portable parser.

Acceptance criteria:
- Private constructors model EDF digest when available, ASC digest, converter executable digest, reported version when available, full option vector, platform, exit status, failsafe mode, and source metadata.
- A manually converted ASC can supply a validated receipt without pretending eyes4s ran the converter.
- Missing converter identity or options produces explicit warnings or failure according to a named strictness policy.
- Source and output paths are display metadata only; persistent identity uses canonical digests.
- Receipt encoding is canonical and suitable for inclusion in scientific provenance and validation artifacts.
- Tests reject blank identity, malformed digests, contradictory states, and fabricated successful conversion receipts.
set.title: Model EDF2ASC conversion provenance and source identity
